name: Full-Grain Leather 3-Pipe Roll
description: Three pipe pouches, a tobacco compartment, and a tool pocket, all rolled into a full-grain vegetable-tanned leather case that will last decades. Handstitched with waxed thread. The leather ages beautifully — it will be dark and supple by the time your grandchildren inherit it.

name: Bridle Leather Cigar Travel Case
description: Holds three cigars up to 60 ring gauge in individual cedar-lined sleeves. Bridle leather exterior with a silver-toned clasp. Compact enough for a jacket pocket; substantial enough to protect your cigars in transit. Made to order in small batches.
